clips.title: The story
paras: Shadowglen is a secluded, twilit vale nestled within the northeastern boughs of Teldrassil. Dominated by the great barrow-tree Aldrassil, it serves as the safe haven where young night elves take their first steps into service before journeying out into the wider world.

Tucked away in the northeastern canopy of Teldrassil, Shadowglen is ringed by high ridges that shelter it from the rest of the world. Bathed in eternal dusk, the vale centers on Aldrassil, a massive barrow-tree whose hollowed trunk houses elders, priestesses, and mentors for young night elves beginning their training. The only route out of the valley leads south through a narrow mountain pass toward Starbreeze Village and Dolanaar, making Shadowglen one of the most naturally fortified and peaceful sanctuaries on the World Tree.
